response.original_title: 愛する夫の為に、身代わり週末肉便器。 超絶倫極悪オヤジに、孕むまで何度も中出しされ続けて…。
response.overview: A once-perfect married life is shattered in an instant. The husband, a business owner, is betrayed by a “friend”—a moneylender—leaving him saddled with massive debt and driving his company into bankruptcy. Desperate to return to the happy life they once knew, the wife decides to meet with the moneylender, keeping it a secret from her husband. “If you want to save your husband, you’ll be my woman—but only on the weekends!” Believing that she alone can endure this, she resolves to sacrifice her body. And so begins a series of humiliating weekends, serving as a “sex toy” in her husband’s stead—an ordeal that will not end until she is pregnant…
response.title: For the Sake of My Beloved Husband, I Sacrifice Myself as Weekend Flesh Toilet: Repeatedly Impregnated by a Depraved, Hyper-Virile Old Man…
